title: Provider profiles
description: Every provider profile in the company.

help.title: About provider profiles
help.overview: A provider profile is how a person appears as a service provider: bio, skills, portfolio, weekly availability and rating. It also holds the Stripe account their payouts go to. Each person has one.

sections.title: The profile
items: Bio, skills and portfolio show on your public pages.
Availability is a list of weekly time slots, such as Monday 9:00 to 17:00.
The rating and the share of orders completed come from reviews and finished orders; you can't type them.
Here you see every provider profile of the company, and a new one asks whose it is. Each person also edits their own in their account, under Provider profile.

sections.title: Payouts
items: Connect Stripe payouts opens Stripe to set up, or finish setting up, your own payout account.
Refresh Stripe status shows whether Stripe has approved your payments and payouts.
When a client's payment for an order is released, your share goes to this account.
